entries.purpose: Convert valid segment assimilation and final water allocation into a bounded relative opportunity signal.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: assimilation_fraction = clamp(max(net_assimilation, 0) / stage_assimilation_reference, 0, 1); water_fulfilment = requested > 0 ? clamp(realized / requested, 0, 1) : 1; opportunity = min(assimilation_fraction, water_fulfilment).
entries.source_title: P2R Growth and Gameplay Consequence Architecture
entries.valid_domain: Valid P1 segment assimilation and final shared water allocation; relative opportunity only, never biomass.
assumptions: P1 physiology remains the scientific source of assimilation and water allocation.
Negative assimilation produces zero relative opportunity and is not interpreted as biomass loss.
notes: Hydraulic beta, thermal severity, radiation severity, recovery, and persistent damage are not multiplied into this signal.

entries.purpose: Advance configured development stages using relative opportunity budgets and explicit optional gates.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: stage_progress = clamp(stage_opportunity_accumulated / required_stage_opportunity, 0, 1); transition when the opportunity budget and configured elapsed-time/dark-duration gates are satisfied, carrying exact segment remainder forward.
entries.source_title: P2R Growth and Gameplay Consequence Architecture
entries.valid_domain: Four explicitly ordered configured stages: seedling, vegetative, flowering, harvest_ready.
assumptions: No universal Cannabis stage duration or photoperiod threshold is supplied.
Configured values are calibration data and may be synthetic only in fixtures.
notes: Stage progress is not a biomass or harvest prediction.

entries.purpose: Integrate supported water, thermal, and radiation consequence channels into dose, recovery, and persistent damage state.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: dose += severity * dt; damage_dose += max(0, severity - damage_onset) * dt; damage = clamp(damage_dose / damage_scale, 0, 1); recovery_next = recovery_current*exp(-k*dt) + severity*(1-exp(-k*dt)).
entries.source_title: P2R Growth and Gameplay Consequence Architecture
entries.valid_domain: Bounded configured channel severities in [0,1]; deterministic non-negative segment duration.
assumptions: Dose and persistent damage are transparent gameplay accumulators, not cellular injury laws.
Persistent damage is monotonic in P2.0; recovery does not erase historical dose or damage.
notes: No random damage and no generic health scalar are used.

entries.purpose: Project decomposed authoritative consequence state into observable symptoms, deterministic reason records, and a player condition label.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: Derive presentation channels from authoritative state using configured presentation thresholds and explicit precedence: unavailable, critical, damaged, recovering, stressed, thriving/stable.
entries.source_title: P2R Growth and Gameplay Consequence Architecture
entries.valid_domain: Presentation only; never feeds back into P1 or P2 integration.
assumptions: Presentation thresholds are gameplay configuration, not biological constants.
Reason codes are emitted by the deterministic simulator and do not use AI inference.
notes: The projection contains no authoritative health field.
